# Unit OLED (U119) reference-redrawn artwork

Updated 2026-10-26. Rear product label. The visible operating front has no permanent product label in the exact references. The exact SKU has no matching supplied original in the local source lookup; this update follows the user's authorization to redraw clearly readable official product photographs. Each print is explicitly `reference-redraw`.

Readable copy reproduced: OLED, 128*64 Pixels, 1.3 inch, SH1107, Address: 0x3C bit-7, PORT. A. I2C, SCL / SDA / 5V / GND. Text, color blocks and visible symbols are independently reconstructed as high-resolution final PNGs. No product-photo pixels, crops or transformed photo patches are used. The reference photographs establish content and appearance, not manufacturing tolerances. Font shapes, exact color and icon curves remain reconstruction estimates.

- [Official photograph](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/oled/oled_02.webp) — SHA-256 `d0b12cd5aa83cd63da27203a713c18b7f4da974bf41d26db89b8f46d05a82424`.

Only approved final PNGs and physical-surface registration code are public. Source table, source links from that table, private mappings, vector redraws, generators and intermediate files remain private. Final image permission does not transfer artwork ownership; project code and official CAD keep their existing MIT notices.

`artwork:false` removes every label. Prints project onto existing native surface triangles, preserving openings. No film bridge or new physical closing surface was added. [sticker-check.json](./sticker-check.json) proves exact pre-edit equality of every nonprinted buffer/index/normal/material/world transform/component/port and checks four-wire Grove attachment, pose, detachment and disposal. Screen/optical/ventilation boundaries are checked where applicable. The original model's functional visual API is unchanged.

Remaining boundaries:

- The removable screen shipping/protective film with size arrows and the package label are omitted from the default operating model so the external framebuffer remains unobstructed.
- Fonts, colors and icon curves are visual reference reconstructions; not the original manufacturing artwork.
- No browser or exhaustive face inspection; 3D placement remains an unverified visual registration.
